title: Derive a Key from a Password
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Derive a Key from a Password.
learning_objectives: Explain derive a key from a password using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for derive a key from a password
Assess failure and operational limits of derive a key from a password
concepts_covered: PBKDF2 turns a password and salt into key bytes; a salt is stored with the encrypted data and is not itself secret.
deriveKey uses PBKDF2-SHA256, 120000 iterations, and 32-byte output.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
